title: Space Pirate Amai
description:
Embrace Space Piracy with this retro style space shooter. 

Join Space Pirate Amai and her crew on a quest to destroy everything in her path!

Old school 2d shooter with crazy music by the indie band 8bit Phantom Galactic!



-Challenging retro space shooter

-Fight your way through various stages and enemies.

-Intense Boss fights!

-Master the use of your shield to survive.

-Use powerups to upgrade your ship's weapons!
